result: Al I — four IR lines, 1D-LTE, on repo-owned regions
status: A REAL MEASUREMENT, and still NOT promotable: it is 1D-LTE only, because the Al_Amarsi2020 grid carries no IR wavelength. Reported as 1D-LTE, not as a final A(Al).

7835.309.ew_source: Kitt Peak lm0780, local continuum from the 95th percentile of clean side-bands

8772.866.ew_source: INTEGRATED ABSORPTION (Kitt Peak lm0876) — an UPPER BOUND, it includes any blend

the_comparison: the optical pair gave 6.601 and 6.262 — spread 0.339 dex. The IR set spreads 0.032. A factor of TEN, and the within-pair agreement is 0.003 and 0.001 dex.
why_it_is_credible_and_asplund_is_not_th: TWO separate wavelength regions, 783 nm and 877 nm — a shared systematic would have to act identically 90 nm apart
TWO instruments (IAG and Kitt Peak) corroborate the depths to 1-2%
gf from a NIST pull at B (<=10%) and B+ (<=7%), against C+ (<=18%) on the optical pair
all four cleared the pipeline's own EW sanity filter, 4 in and 4 out
agreement with Asplund 2021 is CORROBORATION and is deliberately not the criterion; the lines were selected, measured and graded before any abundance was computed
honest_caveats: 1D-LTE ONLY. No NLTE correction exists for any IR Al line. The optical NLTE deltas were -0.028 and -0.017, so an IR correction of similar size would move the mean by ~0.02 dex, but that is an ASSUMPTION about unmeasured lines and is not applied.

8772/8773 EWs are integrated absorption, i.e. UPPER bounds that include any blend. They are also the two HIGHER values (+0.027, +0.028). That is internally consistent with slight over-measurement, and a proper profile fit would likely tighten the spread further.
8773.896 sits AT the -4.9 REW ceiling, so its A is the most sensitive to saturation treatment of the four.
the region file's damping constants are INHERITED from the Al 6696 template, not derived for these transitions. Stated because it is the least-defended number in the chain.
what_changed: the blocker was never the data. Building four line regions from the NIST pull turned a 'no region, no abundance' dead end into a four-line measurement in one step.
